"""Derive P1 excerpts/arithmetic from saved text and P0 only; no host queries."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

R = Path(__file__).parent
REPO = Path('$REPO_ROOT')
TARGET = Path('$TARGET_REVIEW_ROOT')
P0 = Path('$WINDOWS_INVENTORY_ROOT')
GiB = 1024**3
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(name, value):
    with (R/name).open('x', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as f:
        json.dump(value, f, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2); f.write('\n')
base = json.loads((R/'baseline.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
for name,digest in base['prior_snapshots'].items(): assert sha(REPO/'docs/cookbook/evidence'/name)==digest, name
sources = json.loads((R/'sources.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert len(sources)==8 and all(s.get('status')==200 and 'error' not in s for s in sources)
texts={}
for s in sources:
    assert sha(R/(s['id']+'.raw'))==s['sha256']
    assert sha(R/(s['id']+'.txt'))==s['text_sha256']
    texts[s['id']] = (R/(s['id']+'.txt')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
p0 = json.loads((REPO/'docs/cookbook/evidence/m00-t05-windows-inventory.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
obs = {name: group['data'] for name,group in p0['observations']['groups'].items()}
assert obs['os']['build']=='26300' and obs['os_release']=={'display_version':'26H2','update_build_revision':9711}
assert '26H2\nGeneral Availability Channel\n2026-09-29\n2028-10-10\n2029-10-09\n2026-10 B\n2026-10-13\n26300.9711' in texts['windows-releases']
assert '16GB of free space' in texts['studio-install'] and 'GPU with 4GB VRAM' in texts['studio-install']
assert 'December 31, 2026' in texts['emulator-acceleration']
assert 'A JVM version between 17 and 25' in texts['gradle-931-compatibility']
assert 'Android Gradle plugin 9.1.1 (April 2026)' in texts['agp-910-release']
assert 'Gradle is tested with Kotlin 2.0.0 through 2.3.0-RC.' in texts['gradle-931-compatibility']
assert 'Gradle is tested with Android Gradle Plugin 8.13 through 9.0.0-beta02.' in texts['gradle-931-compatibility']
ranges = {
    'studio-install': [(1819,1894)],
    'emulator-acceleration': [(591,609),(674,691),(767,795)],
    'windows-releases': [(44,63),(129,139)],
    'hyperv-hardware': [(122,125)],
    'gradle-931-compatibility': [(291,295),(370,372),(470,491)],
    'agp-910-release': [(417,459)],
    'sdk-environment': [(471,490),(575,590)],
    'avd-management': [(595,619),(980,987),(1002,1015)],
}
excerpts=[]
for name,spans in ranges.items():
    lines=texts[name].splitlines()
    for start,end in spans:
        excerpts.append({'source':name,'text_lines':[start,end],'text':'\n'.join(lines[start-1:end])})
old_source = next(s for s in json.loads((TARGET/'sources.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if s['id']=='flutter-android-source')
flutter_file = TARGET/'flutter-android-source.txt'
assert sha(flutter_file)==old_source['text_sha256']
flutter = flutter_file.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
constants={key:re.search(r'const '+key+r" = '([^']+)'",flutter)[1] for key in ['templateDefaultGradleVersion','templateAndroidGradlePluginVersion','templateKotlinGradlePluginVersion','ndkVersion']}
assert constants == {'templateDefaultGradleVersion':'9.3.1','templateAndroidGradlePluginVersion':'9.1.0','templateKotlinGradlePluginVersion':'2.4.0','ndkVersion':'28.2.13676358'}
rows=[('Retained compressed inputs',5),('Expanded JDK/SDK/build tools/NDK/emulator',10),('One expanded system image',4),('One AVD userdata/cache/snapshot allowance',6),('Gradle/Pub caches and build output',6),('Logs and contingency',1)]
checkout_growth=sum(n for _,n in rows)
assert checkout_growth==32
reserve=20  # New proposal, NOT inherited approval from the old JS retry.
comparison={}
for role,growth in [('temporary_volume',2),('checkout_volume',checkout_growth)]:
    free=obs[role]['free_bytes']; required=(growth+reserve)*GiB
    comparison[role]={'saved_free_bytes':free,'proposed_growth_gib':growth,'proposed_free_reserve_gib':reserve,'required_start_free_bytes':required,'margin_bytes':free-required,'fits_proposed_envelope':free>=required}
assert comparison['temporary_volume']['fits_proposed_envelope']
assert not comparison['checkout_volume']['fits_proposed_envelope']
findings={
    'kind':'P1 static comparison; setup held, no new platform/pin/budget approval',
    'sources':sources, 'source_response_bytes':sum(s['bytes'] for s in sources), 'excerpts':excerpts,
    'saved_p0_snapshot_sha256':sha(REPO/'docs/cookbook/evidence/m00-t05-windows-inventory.json'),
    'saved_host_facts':obs,
    'windows_match':{'release':'26H2','gac_build':'26300.9711','revision_date':'2026-10-13','home_pro_end_of_updates':'2028-10-10','limit':'Matches the saved P0 tuple to the fetched public table, not live patch verification or complete security clearance.'},
    'flutter_source':{'url':old_source['url'],'saved_text_sha256':sha(flutter_file),'text_lines':[30,75],'excerpt':'\n'.join(flutter.splitlines()[29:75]),'template_constants':constants},
    'native_pair_limits':['AGP URL names 9.1.0 but current heading/compatibility text describes 9.1.1; not an immutable 9.1.0 manifest or patch adoption.', 'Gradle 9.3.1 published tested Kotlin/AGP ranges do not cover all selected-template versions; missing coverage is not proof of incompatibility. No silent upgrade/downgrade or rule relaxation.'],
    'budget_proposal':{'approved':False,'measured_package_footprint':False,'unit_bytes':GiB,'checkout_rows_gib':dict(rows),'checkout_growth_gib':checkout_growth,'temporary_growth_gib':2,'proposed_reserve_each_gib':reserve,'per_volume':comparison,'assumptions':['One AVD, serial build/run; external root on checkout volume, not inside repository.', 'No new Android Studio or Flutter SDK duplication included; any reuse requires separate approval and fresh identity verification.', 'Package roster/extracted sizes, native hooks and paths must be reviewed before acquisition; revise estimates rather than install to discover size.', 'Twenty GiB reserve is an unaccepted new proposal, not inherited from the old JS retry; no cleanup/move/purchase authorized.']},
    'scope':{'public_text_requests':8,'host_queries':0,'candidate_sdk_commands':0,'binary_downloads':0,'installs':0,'native_browser_tests':0,'budget_approved':False,'setup_approved':False},
    'historical_p0_validator_sha256':sha(P0/'validate.py'),
    'limits':['Integrated Iris Xe name/driver does not establish the published 4GB-VRAM condition; shared system RAM is not proof.', 'WHPX is the official recommendation, not an observed installed/usable feature. No AEHD/HAXM fallback or security-feature disablement.', 'GPU software rendering and CPU VM acceleration are separate; neither is physical-device or performance proof.'],
}
save('findings.json',findings)
for role,c in comparison.items(): print(role,'required',c['required_start_free_bytes']/GiB,'GiB; saved margin',round(c['margin_bytes']/GiB,2),'GiB')

      "text": "Minimum for Android Studio, and Android Studio with the Android Emulator.
The minimum requirements listed allow you to get started with Android
Studio and typically apply to the following use cases:
Creating and supporting smaller projects and samples.

Android Device Streaming

Some minimum requirements differ depending on whether you want to run
Android Studio alone or Android Studio with the Android Emulator. In those
cases, both requirements are listed and labelled accordingly with either
Studio
or
Studio & Emulator
.
Recommended to run Android Studio and the Android Emulator.
These are the recommended system specifications to run Android Studio and the
Android Emulator. This typically covers the following use cases:
Professional development on larger, more complex codebases.
Note:
Larger projects require higher RAM and CPU specs for compilation and
loading in the IDE.
Creating multiple Android Virtual Devices (AVD), including XR devices.
Note:
You might need up to 6GB of additional storage for each additional AVD
created.

Note:

memory per AVD. The exact amount might vary depending on your system.

      ],
      "text": "MIPS-based system images on Intel or AMD CPUs, can't use the VM
acceleration that is described on this page.
Virtualization extension requirements
In addition to the development environment requirements, your computer's
processor must support virtualization extensions. Supported processors are:
Intel Processors with Intel Virtualization Technology (VT-x, vmx), such as
Intel Core iX and Intel Core Ultra processors
AMD Processors with AMD-V (SVM), such as AMD Ryzen processors
Apple silicon
Additional Requirements for Intel and AMD processors:
Second-level address translation (Intel EPT or AMD RVI) is required for Intel
and AMD processors. Most modern Intel and AMD processors support second-level
address translation. Only the first-generation Intel or AMD processors offering
virtualization extensions may not have second-level page translations.
If you're unsure whether your processor supports the required extensions,
check the specifications for your processor on the manufacturer's site. If your
processor doesn't support these extensions, then you can't use VM acceleration.

"""Capture the P1 static review once; preserve every earlier snapshot."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

R=Path(__file__).parent
REPO=Path('$REPO_ROOT')
OUT=REPO/'docs/cookbook/evidence/m00-t05-emulator-feasibility.json'
assert not OUT.exists()
def sha(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
base=json.loads((R/'baseline.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert len(base['prior_snapshots'])==12
for name,digest in base['prior_snapshots'].items(): assert sha((OUT.parent/name).read_bytes())==digest,name
for name,digest in base['repo_files'].items(): assert sha((REPO/name).read_bytes())==digest,name
findings=json.loads((R/'findings.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert findings['scope']['public_text_requests']==8 and not findings['budget_proposal']['approved']
for source in findings['sources']:
    assert sha((R/(source['id']+'.raw')).read_bytes())==source['sha256']
    assert sha((R/(source['id']+'.txt')).read_bytes())==source['text_sha256']
files=[]
normalizations={R.as_posix():'$EMULATOR_FEASIBILITY_ROOT',REPO.as_posix():'$REPO_ROOT','$TARGET_REVIEW_ROOT':'$TARGET_REVIEW_ROOT','$WINDOWS_INVENTORY_ROOT':'$WINDOWS_INVENTORY_ROOT'}
for name in ['baseline.json','fetch.py','sources.json','derive.py','findings.json','capture.py']:
    raw=(R/name).read_bytes(); text=raw.decode('utf-8')
    for source,replacement in normalizations.items(): text=text.replace(source,replacement)
    files.append({'path':name,'original_bytes':len(raw),'original_sha256':sha(raw),'normalized_text_sha256':sha(text.encode('utf-8')),'text':text})
record={'kind':'M00-T05 P1 static Windows/emulator feasibility review; setup held, budgets unapproved','captured_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'scope':base['scope'],'prior_snapshots':base['prior_snapshots'],'source_retention':'Eight full public HTML responses and extracted text remain in the separate external root, with exact hashes in sources.json; selected excerpts/arithmetic retained in findings.json. No executable/archive or package installed.','files':files}
with OUT.open('x',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as f: json.dump(record,f,indent=2,ensure_ascii=True);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'files':len(files),'snapshot_bytes':OUT.stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(OUT.read_bytes()),'prior_snapshots_unchanged':12,'public_text_responses':8},indent=2))
